passages.title: An Unforgettable Evening at Riverside Bistro
passages.titleVi: Một buổi tối đáng nhớ tại quán ăn ven sông
passages.text: Last Friday evening, my family gathered for a special dinner at a charming riverside restaurant. Before arriving, my sister and I stopped at a small neighborhood cafe to have afternoon tea and chat about our week. When we stepped into the dining room of the bistro, soft acoustic music and warm golden lighting created a cozy atmosphere. A friendly waiter greeted us politely at the entrance and escorted us to a quiet corner table overlooking the river. A few minutes later, our attentive waitress handed us the dinner menus and recommended the chef's specialty dish of the evening. To begin our meal, we ordered a crisp garden salad tossed with creamy balsamic dressing and crunchy croutons. My father preferred a thin-crust Italian pizza topped with fresh herbs, mushrooms, and melted cheese, while my mother chose a freshly cooked salmon fillet served with steamed broccoli. When the food arrived, everything smelled wonderful and tasted absolutely delicious. We ate our dinner leisurely while sharing funny childhood memories and laughing together. The staff checked on our table regularly to refill water glasses and ensure that every guest felt welcome. After finishing our dinner, we thanked both the waiter and the waitress for their outstanding hospitality. Dining together in such a peaceful setting reminded us of how important family moments truly are. As we walked out along the illuminated riverbank, the pleasant evening breeze provided a perfect ending to our wonderful dinner gathering. Sharing delicious meals in such a warm and scenic setting reminds us how important friendly conversations are for our well-being.

passages.text: Dining out at a distinguished culinary establishment offers an exquisite journey into creative cooking and hospitality. Last Saturday, our family celebrated an anniversary by reserving a cozy corner table at The Grand Bistro downtown. As we sat down, our courteous waiter presented the dinner menu, highlighting seasonal chef specialties alongside traditional continental fare. Before the main dishes arrived, the kitchen team began to mix fresh herbs into savory garlic butter, while an apprentice perfected the salad by mixing delicate organic greens with balsamic vinaigrette. The chef also offered an artisanal seafood appetizer featuring thinly sliced raw sea bass seasoned with crushed pink peppercorns and extra virgin olive oil. When the main courses arrived, the enticing aromas delighted our senses. My father ordered tender roasted chicken seasoned with fragrant herbs, while my brother chose a mildly spicy coconut curry served alongside aromatic basmati rice. Each dish delivered an extraordinary depth of balanced flavor, proving that patient preparation elevates simple ingredients into culinary masterpieces. In the bustling open kitchen, experienced line cooks monitored each hot skillet diligently to ensure that delicate crusts were never burnt. Beside them, another cook tossed golden fried potatoes with rosemary until they achieved a crisp exterior and fluffy center. Attentive servers moved gracefully across the dining room to serve hot dishes promptly and replenish sparkling water glasses. When our meal concluded, we left a generous cash tip on the table to express our heartfelt appreciation for the outstanding service and warm atmosphere. Walking out into the pleasant evening air, we agreed that sharing a memorable feast nourishes both body and spirit.

passages.titleVi: Lớp học nghệ thuật ẩm thực cuối tuần của bếp trưởng
passages.text: Every Saturday, our municipal culinary academy hosts a popular community workshop where aspiring food lovers learn essential culinary arts. The head chef begins the morning lesson by demonstrating how different cooking methods highlight natural flavors in everyday eats. To initiate the multi-course meal, apprentices prepare an appetizing starter featuring crisp sourdough bruschetta and creamy garlic spread. Next, the chef explains the importance of precise heat control when preparing vegetables. Students gently boil tender young potatoes in sea-salted water until soft, while a junior instructor plates delicate boiled carrots sprinkled with fresh chopped herbs. Across the kitchen line, students learn how to fry crunchy golden fritters in heated olive oil, testing the temperature carefully so the batter never absorbs excess grease. Nearby, roasting stations fill the room with mouthwatering aromas as cooks roast whole herb-rubbed chickens alongside sliced root vegetables in a convection oven. The chef emphasizes that patient baking transforms raw dough into culinary gold, teaching students the art of artisanal bread making. Everyone watches in awe as golden brown baked baguettes emerge from the stone deck oven with a hollow crackling crust. He also demonstrates how to bake flaky fruit tartlets until the caramelized sugar bubbles gently. To complete the banquet, the pastry team presents an exquisite dessert consisting of warm chocolate lava cake topped with cool vanilla bean ice cream. Satisfied participants sit down together around a communal dining table, celebrating their teamwork and tasting every handmade creation. Mastering diverse cooking techniques enriches domestic hospitality and turns daily meals into joyous celebrations.

passages.title: A Delightful Community Food Fair and Evening Feast
passages.titleVi: Hội chợ ẩm thực cộng đồng thú vị và bữa tiệc tối
passages.text: Every autumn, our university campus hosts a vibrant community food festival celebrating diverse cultural traditions and international cuisine. Students, faculty members, and local neighbors eagerly gather to explore an exciting variety of dining options. In the afternoon, energetic crowds packed inside the spacious campus cafeteria to sample delicious specialty dishes prepared by enthusiastic student clubs. One popular corner station proudly displayed fresh organic platters for each visiting vegan guest, featuring spiced lentil patties and roasted garden vegetables. Across the sunny lawn, an outdoor smokehouse pit filled the crisp autumn breeze with savory aromas from slow-cooked hickory barbecue. Hungry attendees queued patiently beside the bustling open grill to order juicy grilled skewers, sweet caramelized corn cobs, and warm flatbreads. A coastal seafood vendor served generous platters of freshly caught ocean seafood paired with chilled citrus water and tangy garlic dipping sauce. Beside the lively grill station, happy children smiled brightly as friendly cooks handed them baskets of golden, crispy French fries sprinkled with crushed sea salt. Nearby, a boutique food stall showcased delicate smoked salmon canapes layered carefully on crunchy rye sourdough toast. For dessert, talented local bakers presented flaky puff pastries topped with sweet blackberry glaze and fluffy vanilla whipped cream. Guests were equally delighted by generous slices of warm homemade apple crumble pie infused with aromatic cinnamon and nutmeg. As dusk gently settled over the grounds, neighborhood families and friends gathered together around long wooden picnic tables for a restful communal supper. Sharing wholesome food and cheerful conversation under string lights strengthened bonds and celebrated community unity. Everyone returned home feeling refreshed and deeply thankful for an unforgettable festival filled with exceptional flavor and genuine warmth.

passages.titleVi: Một buổi tối ẩm thực tại quán pub và nhà hàng trung tâm
passages.text: Liam invited his old college friends to celebrate the weekend at an energetic downtown pub. The popular neighborhood eatery was renowned for catering to varied dietary preferences with fresh local ingredients. The server greeted their table warmly and offered to pour sparkling mineral water while everyone browsed the extensive menu. For starters, the group ordered a popular sharing combo that featured crispy Mexican taco bites and delicate Japanese salmon sushi rolls. The head chef emphasized that all seasonal vegetables were certified organic and delivered daily from nearby farms rather than relying on frozen processed foods. Liam chose a hearty grilled mushroom burger paired with a generous slice of melted cheddar cheese and seasoned roasted potatoes. His friend Maya ordered a traditional homemade shepherd's pie, delighting in its rich savory taste and golden crust. To accompany their meal, they sipped freshly squeezed lemonade containing tart fruit pulp that perfectly balanced the rich dinner flavors. The bustling dining room echoed with friendly conversation, clinking glasses, and pleasant background music. Before leaving, the attentive staff checked whether any diners wished to try their artisanal dessert selection or specialty roasted coffee. Everyone praised the courteous hospitality and agreed that the restaurant offered outstanding culinary value. As they stepped out into the cool evening air, the friends promised to make this lively gastro-pub their regular weekend gathering spot. Sharing such delicious dishes created cherished memories, proving that good food and great company always make the finest recipe for happiness. Patrons left with satisfied smiles, already planning their next visit to celebrate another weekend with delicious local specialties.

passages.title: The Grand Culinary Gala: A Feast of Fresh Flavors and Inclusive Dining
passages.text:
The annual international gastronomy gala hosted an extraordinary charity banquet inside the Grand Plaza Hotel's magnificent crystal-lit ballroom, welcoming hundreds of distinguished food enthusiasts. Renowned executive chefs collaborated tirelessly for weeks to design an inclusive gourmet menu catering to every guest's individual dietary preferences and cultural traditions. Gleaming dining tables were decorated elegantly with fine white linen, polished silver cutlery, and fragrant arrangements of fresh garden orchids. Attentive servers welcomed arriving patrons with sparkling botanical drinks that awakened everyone's healthy appetite for the lavish culinary feast ahead.

The culinary team took enormous professional pride in selecting certified organic heirloom vegetables and herbs harvested directly from neighboring sustainable family farms at dawn. Every single cooking ingredient was inspected with meticulous care to guarantee exceptional flavor, impeccable freshness, and maximum nutritional value. Diners thoroughly enjoyed freshly baked artisan sourdough bread with whipped herb butter alongside a magnificent centerpiece of slow-roasted root vegetables glazed in sweet balsamic reduction. To satisfy plant-based guests, talented chefs created a colorful vegetarian masterpiece that delivered rich nutritional protein without sacrificing mouthwatering gourmet taste.

Later in the evening, waiters brought out an array of tempting handcrafted desserts featuring caramelized fruit tarts and silky chocolate mousse. Guests happily devoured each tasty creation, marveling at the harmonious harmony between subtle sweet notes and zesty citrus undertones. Warm toasts and joyful conversations echoed across the hall as strangers connected effortlessly over shared appreciation for exceptional hospitality. Ultimately, this unforgettable banquet demonstrated that modern dining achieves true excellence when culinary artistry combines sustainable ingredients, nutritional awareness, and genuine warmth for every diner.

sentencePairs.vi: Cuối cùng, bữa đại tiệc khó quên này đã chứng minh rằng ẩm thực hiện đại đạt đến sự hoàn hảo đích thực khi nghệ thuật nấu nướng kết hợp các nguyên liệu bền vững, ý thức dinh dưỡng và sự đón tiếp nồng hậu chân thành dành cho mọi thực khách.

pronunciationNotesVi: Từ 'banquet' (/ˈbæŋ.kwət/): Trọng âm chính nhấn mạnh vào âm tiết thứ nhất 'ban-', nguyên âm bẹt /æ/ kết hợp âm mũi ngạc mềm /ŋ/, âm tiết sau '-quet' kết thúc bằng cụm phụ âm /-kwət/ dứt khoát.
Từ 'vegetarian' (/ˌvedʒ.əˈter.i.ən/): Trọng âm chính rơi vào âm tiết thứ ba mang nguyên âm đôi '-ter-' (/ter/), âm đầu mang trọng âm phụ /ˌvedʒ/ với phụ âm bật tắc xát /dʒ/ chuẩn xác.

Từ 'appetite' (/ˈæp.ə.taɪt/): Trọng âm chính rơi vào âm tiết đầu 'ap-', âm tiết giữa nhược hóa thành schwa /ə/, âm tiết cuối '-tite' mang nguyên âm đôi /aɪ/ và kết thúc bằng phụ âm vô thanh bật hơi /-t/.
Hiện tượng nối âm phụ âm sang nguyên âm trong 'tasty creation' và 'harvested at' (/ˈhɑːr.və.stɪd æt/): Âm bật /-d/ nối trực tiếp sang nguyên âm /æ/ tạo dòng chảy ngữ lưu mượt mà.

comprehensionQuestions.question: Where was the international gastronomy charity banquet hosted according to the passage?
options: Inside the Grand Plaza Hotel's crystal-lit ballroom.
On an open-air wooden ferry boat crossing a mountain lake.
Inside an underground sports locker room after a soccer match.
At an outdoor construction site warehouse beside a highway.
comprehensionQuestions.explanationVi: Đoạn một chỉ rõ bữa đại tiệc từ thiện ẩm thực được tổ chức bên trong phòng khiêu vũ ánh pha lê tráng lệ của Khách sạn Grand Plaza ('inside the Grand Plaza Hotel's magnificent crystal-lit ballroom').

comprehensionQuestions.question: How did the kitchen cater to the dietary requirements of plant-based guests?
options: By creating a colorful vegetarian masterpiece rich in nutritional plant protein.
By serving only packaged canned potato chips and instant dry crackers.
By offering them leftover bread crusts from the dessert pastry station.
By asking vegetarian diners to bring their own meals from local convenience stores.
comprehensionQuestions.explanationVi: Đoạn hai nêu rõ các đầu bếp tài ba đã tạo nên một kiệt tác món chay đầy màu sắc, cung cấp nguồn đạm dinh dưỡng dồi dào mà không làm mất đi hương vị thơm ngon ('created a colorful vegetarian masterpiece that delivered rich nutritional protein').

comprehensionQuestions.question: According to the concluding paragraph, when does modern dining achieve true excellence?
options: When culinary artistry combines sustainable ingredients, nutritional awareness, and genuine warmth for every diner.
When restaurant owners charge the highest possible prices to exclude ordinary citizens.
When banquets strictly prohibit all forms of conversation and background music.
When food is imported exclusively from overseas factories using artificial preservatives.
comprehensionQuestions.explanationVi: Câu kết khẳng định ẩm thực hiện đại đạt đến sự hoàn hảo đích thực khi nghệ thuật nấu nướng kết hợp các nguyên liệu bền vững, ý thức dinh dưỡng và sự đón tiếp nồng hậu ('when culinary artistry combines sustainable ingredients, nutritional awareness, and genuine warmth for every diner').

passages.titleVi: Đại tiệc ẩm thực hoành tráng: Bữa tiệc của hương vị tươi ngon và phong cách ẩm thực phong phú

passages.title: A Memorable Evening at the Culinary Buffet
passages.titleVi: Một buổi tối đáng nhớ tại bữa tiệc buffet ẩm thực

sentencePairs.en: Every Saturday evening, our neighborhood bistro transforms its dining hall to host an extraordinary international buffet.
sentencePairs.vi: Vào mỗi tối thứ Bảy, quán ăn nhỏ trong khu phố của chúng tôi chuyển đổi hội trường ăn uống để tổ chức một bữa tiệc buffet quốc tế đặc sắc.

sentencePairs.en: Renowned executive chefs demonstrate their impressive culinary expertise by preparing savory dishes from around the world.
sentencePairs.vi: Các bếp trưởng điều hành danh tiếng thể hiện chuyên môn ẩm thực ấn tượng của họ bằng cách chế biến các món ăn thơm ngon từ khắp nơi trên thế giới.

sentencePairs.en: The restaurant staff works tirelessly to cater to every guest, offering fresh seafood, tender roasted meats, and organic garden salads.
sentencePairs.vi: Nhân viên nhà hàng làm việc không biết mệt mỏi để phục vụ chu đáo từng thực khách, mang đến hải sản tươi sống, các món thịt nướng mềm và salad vườn hữu cơ.

sentencePairs.en: Hungry diners marvel at crispy skewered chicken pieces that are generously dipped into warm, fragrant peanut sauce.
sentencePairs.vi: Những thực khách đang đói bụng trầm trồ trước những xiên gà giòn rụm được nhúng ngập trong nước sốt đậu phộng ấm nóng thơm phức.

sentencePairs.en: Crystal chandeliers shine brightly across the spacious dining room, illuminating vibrant flower arrangements on every polished wooden table.
sentencePairs.vi: Những chiếc đèn chùm pha lê tỏa sáng rực rỡ khắp phòng ăn rộng rãi, chiếu rọi những lẵng hoa tươi tắn trên từng chiếc bàn gỗ sáng bóng.

sentencePairs.en: The warm brightness of the ambient lanterns creates an inviting atmosphere for celebrating families and weary tourists alike.
sentencePairs.vi: Độ sáng ấm áp từ những chiếc đèn lồng xung quanh tạo nên một không khí thân thiện mời gọi cho cả các gia đình đi liên hoan lẫn du khách mệt mỏi.

sentencePairs.en: In the executive lounge, well-dressed businessmen gather to discuss international trade partnerships over delicate gourmet appetizers.
sentencePairs.vi: Tại phòng chờ sang trọng, các nam doanh nhân ăn mặc chỉnh tề tụ họp để bàn thảo về quan hệ đối tác thương mại quốc tế bên các món khai vị hảo hạng tinh tế.

sentencePairs.en: Head chef Julian loves to cultivate close relationships with local farmers who supply heirloom herbs and seasonal vegetables.
sentencePairs.vi: Bếp trưởng Julian rất thích vun đắp mối quan hệ thân thiết với các nông dân địa phương, những người cung cấp các loại rau thơm gia truyền và rau củ theo mùa.

sentencePairs.en: Running this prestigious culinary establishment represents a lifelong endeavor dedicated to promoting wholesome hospitality and community friendship.
sentencePairs.vi: Vận hành cơ sở ẩm thực danh tiếng này là một nỗ lực cả đời cống hiến cho việc phát huy lòng hiếu khách chân thành và tình bạn cộng đồng.

sentencePairs.en: Between rich tasting courses, attentive servers present refreshing cleansing herbal tea that gently purifies the palate.
sentencePairs.vi: Giữa các đợt thưởng thức món ăn đậm đà, những người phục vụ chu đáo dâng lên tách trà thảo mộc thanh lọc tươi mát giúp làm sạch vị giác một cách nhẹ nhàng.

sentencePairs.en: A talented acoustic entertainer strums melodious Spanish ballads on a vintage classical guitar beside the dessert counter.
sentencePairs.vi: Một nghệ sĩ biểu diễn mộc tài năng gảy những khúc ballad Tây Ban Nha du dương trên cây đàn guitar cổ điển bên cạnh quầy tráng miệng.

sentencePairs.en: Almost every food enthusiast in the city visits this lively dining venue to savor sweet pastries and warm chocolate fondues.
sentencePairs.vi: Hầu như mọi người say mê ẩm thực trong thành phố đều ghé thăm địa điểm ăn uống sôi động này để thưởng thức bánh ngọt và lẩu sô-cô-la ấm nóng.

sentencePairs.en: Friendly banquet servers refill empty plates promptly while explaining distinctive regional recipes with genuine enthusiasm and pleasant smiles.
sentencePairs.vi: Những người phục vụ tiệc thân thiện nhanh chóng dọn và làm đầy đĩa thức ăn trong khi giải thích các công thức nấu ăn đặc trưng vùng miền bằng sự nhiệt tình chân thành và nụ cười niềm nở.

sentencePairs.en: Customers appreciate the harmonious blend of fine dining traditions, warm companionship, and delightful melodic entertainment.
sentencePairs.vi: Khách hàng đánh giá cao sự kết hợp hài hòa giữa truyền thống ẩm thực cao cấp, sự đồng hành ấm áp và hình thức giải trí âm nhạc thú vị.

sentencePairs.en: By the time the dinner concludes, satisfied patrons leave with cherished memories of an unforgettable weekend culinary feast.
sentencePairs.vi: Vào thời điểm bữa tối kết thúc, những vị khách hài lòng ra về với những kỷ niệm ấp ủ về một bữa tiệc ẩm thực cuối tuần khó quên.

pronunciationNotesVi: Từ 'buffet' trong tiếng Anh-Mỹ phát âm là /bəˈfeɪ/ hoặc /ˈbʊf.eɪ/, trọng âm thường rơi vào âm tiết thứ hai và chữ cái 't' ở cuối hoàn toàn câm.
Từ 'culinary' có trọng âm rơi vào âm tiết đầu tiên: /ˈkʌl.ə.ner.i/, nguyên âm đầu là /ʌ/ giống như trong từ 'cup'.
Từ 'endeavor' phát âm là /enˈdev.ɚ/, trọng âm nhấn mạnh vào âm tiết thứ hai 'deav' với nguyên âm /e/ ngắn.
Từ 'enthusiast' phát âm là /ɪnˈθuː.zi.æst/, trọng âm rơi vào âm tiết thứ hai 'thu' /ˈθuː/ với âm /θ/ vô thanh cần đặt đầu lưỡi giữa hai hàm răng.

comprehensionQuestions.question: How do the executive chefs demonstrate their culinary expertise at the Saturday evening buffet?
options: By preparing savory international dishes including fresh seafood and roasted meats
By ordering frozen prepackaged fast food from convenience stores
By serving only plain boiled rice and cold tap water
By asking customers to bring their own cooked meals from home
comprehensionQuestions.explanationVi: Câu 2 và 3 nêu rõ: các bếp trưởng thể hiện chuyên môn ẩm thực bằng cách chuẩn bị các món ăn ngon từ khắp nơi trên thế giới, bao gồm hải sản tươi sống và thịt nướng mềm.

comprehensionQuestions.question: What food item is described as being generously dipped into warm, fragrant peanut sauce?
options: Crispy skewered chicken pieces
Stale slices of white sandwich bread
Steamed broccoli florets and carrots
Raw oysters harvested from cold waters
comprehensionQuestions.explanationVi: Câu 4 trong bài viết nêu rõ: 'Hungry diners marvel at crispy skewered chicken pieces that are generously dipped into warm, fragrant peanut sauce'.

comprehensionQuestions.question: Who provides live musical entertainment near the dessert counter during dinner?
options: A talented acoustic entertainer strumming melodious Spanish ballads on a vintage classical guitar
A loud electronic marching band beating heavy drums
An automated computer robot producing artificial synthesized sounds
A choir of opera singers shouting through megaphones
comprehensionQuestions.explanationVi: Câu 11 nêu rõ: 'A talented acoustic entertainer strums melodious Spanish ballads on a vintage classical guitar beside the dessert counter'.

passages.text: Every Saturday evening, our neighborhood bistro transforms its dining hall to host an extraordinary international buffet. Renowned executive chefs demonstrate their impressive culinary expertise by preparing savory dishes from around the world. The restaurant staff works tirelessly to cater to every guest, offering fresh seafood, tender roasted meats, and organic garden salads. Hungry diners marvel at crispy skewered chicken pieces that are generously dipped into warm, fragrant peanut sauce. Crystal chandeliers shine brightly across the spacious dining room, illuminating vibrant flower arrangements on every polished wooden table. The warm brightness of the ambient lanterns creates an inviting atmosphere for celebrating families and weary tourists alike. In the executive lounge, well-dressed businessmen gather to discuss international trade partnerships over delicate gourmet appetizers. Head chef Julian loves to cultivate close relationships with local farmers who supply heirloom herbs and seasonal vegetables. Running this prestigious culinary establishment represents a lifelong endeavor dedicated to promoting wholesome hospitality and community friendship. Between rich tasting courses, attentive servers present refreshing cleansing herbal tea that gently purifies the palate. A talented acoustic entertainer strums melodious Spanish ballads on a vintage classical guitar beside the dessert counter. Almost every food enthusiast in the city visits this lively dining venue to savor sweet pastries and warm chocolate fondues. Friendly banquet servers refill empty plates promptly while explaining distinctive regional recipes with genuine enthusiasm and pleasant smiles. Customers appreciate the harmonious blend of fine dining traditions, warm companionship, and delightful melodic entertainment. By the time the dinner concludes, satisfied patrons leave with cherished memories of an unforgettable weekend culinary feast.
